name: Demons Within
source:
"A soldier of the renowned Dawnbreak Order, the world's frontier against demons and those who worship them, finds himself with something inside him. That something is you. As a weakened demon of Lust, you are bound to this soldier and must accompany him through both joy and hardship while using your powers to help influence him and those around him."

Follow Resnick, a simple wolf soldier fighting to make the world better, in an involving story to learn the truths of the world as it stands from within him. Use your emotion-based powers to influence the wolf and those around him at key moments of the story to change their behavior in different ways. Help or hinder the wolf, setting the path for him to go. Witness plenty of spicy scenes! As a demon of Lust, making him feel Lust makes you stronger, and becoming stronger is essential to increase your influence...

Demons Within is a furry, adult visual novel where you see the world through the eyes of Resnick. Accompany the wolf from within as he interacts with his companions, friends... and enemies.

[Edited from [url=https://sleths.itch.io/demons-within]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“著名的黎明骑士团的一名士兵，世界上对抗恶魔和崇拜者的前线，发现自己体内有某种东西。那东西就是你。作为一个被削弱的欲望恶魔，你与这名士兵有联系，必须陪伴他度过欢乐和艰难，同时利用你的力量帮助影响他和他周围的人。”

跟随雷斯尼克，一个为了让世界变得更美好而奋斗的普通狼兵，在一个引人入胜的故事中了解他内心世界的真相。在故事的关键时刻，利用基于情感的力量影响狼和他周围的人，以不同的方式改变他们的行为。帮助或阻碍狼，为他指明前进的道路。见证大量辛辣场景！作为色魔，让他感觉到色欲会让你变得更强，而变强对于提升你的影响力至关重要……

《恶魔之心》是一部毛茸茸的成人视觉小说，你可以通过雷斯尼克的眼睛看世界。当狼与同伴、朋友……和敌人互动时，从内部陪伴它。

[编辑自[url=https://sleths.itch.io/demons-within]Itch.io[/url]]
